scope_and_method.content_search: cv search deos OR Starbridge OR drorb OR dcluch OR dclutch --limit 10000 --json; capped hits, not exhaustive index search
scope_and_method.human_authorship: cv prompts row count is extractor output, not independently audited human count; synthetic slash commands, shell outputs, pasted agent briefs, nested quoted conversation, fork/prune copies distinguished in selected evidence only
scope_and_method.sources_registered: cv config reports no export sources registered
